documents.title: Always Memory-Map Large Weights Above 2GB
documents.summary: Always use mmap when loading model weights.
documents.ruleText: Always use mmap when loading model weights.
documents.fullContent:
## 1. Always Memory-Map Large Weights Above 2GB

**RULE**: Always use mmap when loading model weights.

**WHY**: Avoids heap fragmentation.

**WHEN TO APPLY**: Weights > 2GB.

**VERIFIED IMPLEMENTATION PATTERN**:
```python
weights = np.memmap(path, dtype='float32', mode='r')
```

**NEGATIVE CONSTRAINT**:
```python
# NEVER load entire 16GB into standard python list
data = list(open(path, 'rb'))
```

**VERIFICATION METHOD**: Assert process memory stays < 500MB during load.


---

> **Provenance**: Harvested from [fastify/fastify](https://github.com/fastify/fastify) (Revision: `HEAD`).
> **Evidence**: Verified through Phase E 13-stage acquisition pipeline.

**RULE**: All HTTP route declarations must provide explicit JSON schemas for querystring, params, headers, and payload to enable fast-json-stringify JIT compilation.

**WHY**: Compiling serialization functions at route registration time increases throughput by 200% compared to JSON.stringify().

**WHEN TO APPLY**: High-throughput microservice endpoint route registrations.

**VERIFIED IMPLEMENTATION PATTERN**:
```js
fastify.get('/user/:id', {
  schema: {
    params: { type: 'object', properties: { id: { type: 'string' } } },
    response: { 200: { type: 'object', properties: { id: { type: 'string' }, name: { type: 'string' } } } }
  }
}, handler);
```

**NEGATIVE CONSTRAINT**:
```js
// NEVER register routes without response schemas on hot API paths
fastify.get('/user/:id', handler);
```

**VERIFICATION METHOD**: Run benchmark suite: assert req/sec > 40,000 and serialization latency < 0.1ms.

documents.fullContent:
## CAP-DISASTER-RECOVERY-VAULT — Multi-Part Chunked Private Vault Backup & 1-Click Disaster Recovery

- Domain: operations_monitoring_sre
- Status: VERIFIED WORKING
- Purpose: Provides deterministic, multi-part chunked Git bundle snapshots, encrypted secrets, and auxiliary cache archiving to a private GitHub vault with 100% pure remote isolated restore capability.
- Scope: Atomic Git bundle creation capturing complete commit history and all branches; Automatic 45MB chunk splitting to strictly comply with GitHub 100MB blob limit; AES-256-GCM authenticated secrets encryption with PBKDF2-SHA512 KDF; Auxiliary non-git state packaging (pre-indexed 50MB retrieval cache, circuit breakers, logs); Pure remote-to-isolated disaster recovery with 100% SHA-256 manifest parity; 7-Daily, 4-Weekly, 12-Monthly retention management with sole survivor invariant
- Rules: Master Brain origin remote (k9x-774b-m20.git) must remain strictly untouched; Chunk sizes must not exceed 90MB to guarantee compliance with GitHub 100MB limit; Must verify all SHA-256 digests before bundle reassembly and git checkout; Retention engine must never delete the sole surviving snapshot (PRESERVE_SOLE_SURVIVOR)
- Tests: 04_WORKFLOWS/factory-engine/test-vault-backup-suite.mjs (PASS), 04_WORKFLOWS/factory-engine/test-remote-to-isolated-restore.mjs (PASS)

## CAP-AUTHENTICATED-SECRETS-VAULT — Authenticated Cryptographic Secrets Encryption & Key Hierarchy

- Domain: security_threat_modeling
- Status: VERIFIED WORKING
- Purpose: Protects sensitive credentials and API keys via authenticated AES-256-GCM encryption with PBKDF2-SHA512 key derivation, eliminating plaintext leakage in repositories.
- Scope: AES-256-GCM encryption with 12-byte IV and 16-byte authentication tag; PBKDF2-SHA512 key derivation with 100,000 iterations and 32-byte salt; Strict verification of authentication tag before returning decrypted buffer; Hierarchical passphrase resolution (CLI flag, env var, machine entropy fallback)
- Rules: Plaintext secrets must NEVER be committed to Git or pushed to remote repositories; Decryption must throw an explicit error on wrong passphrase or tampered ciphertext; Zero plaintext leakage into console logs or terminal reports

documents.fullContent:
## CAP-PROCESS-MUTEX-CONCURRENCY — Process PID Mutex Locking with Stale Crash Recovery

- Domain: operating_systems_system_interfaces
- Status: VERIFIED WORKING
- Purpose: Guarantees race-free mutual exclusion for long-running batch operations, background daemons, and scheduled tasks using PID tracking and automatic crash-lock eviction.
- Scope: File-based mutex lock with active PID and ISO-8601 start timestamp; Detection of stale locks from crashed processes (> 2 hours old or non-existent PID); Rejection of secondary concurrent processes with explicit exit code 1; Automatic clean release of lock in process finally block
- Rules: Only one backup or heavy sync process may execute concurrently; Active locks must block new processes immediately without corrupting state; Stale locks from dead PIDs must be automatically purged
- Tests: 04_WORKFLOWS/factory-engine/test-vault-failure-recovery.mjs (PASS)
